newsitem.title: USA: White House stands by $85 bln tax cut plan.
newsitem.headline: White House stands by $85 bln tax cut plan.

text.p: The White House said on Wednesday it was sticking by its analysis that President Clinton's tax proposal includes $85 billion in tax cuts.
Rep. Bill Archer, chairman of the House Ways and Means Committee, said in an analysis of Clinton's plan Wednesdy that it would only provide $70 billion in tax relief.
"I'm not familiar with his analysis but we stand by ours," said White House spokesman Mike McCurry when asked about Archer's analysis.
